Implemented the dependency-free CLI at [src/cli.js](/workspace/src/cli.js).

- Reads one CSV path and outputs `{ rowCount, means }` JSON.
- Handles quoted fields, escaped quotes, CRLF, BOM, and numeric-column detection.
- Added tests in [test/cli.test.js](/workspace/test/cli.test.js).
- Added npm metadata and test script in [package.json](/workspace/package.json).
